metadata.description: Kadal UI for AI agents: add the data grid to a shadcn/ui project and wire it up properly, from typed columns to saved views.

plugins.name: kadal-ui
plugins.description: Use Kadal UI's data grid (a power-user React data grid on TanStack Table v9 and shadcn/ui with Base UI) in a project: the kadal-ui skill covers installing it from the registry, the column builder, the <DataGrid> props and the composable parts, URL state and server-side mode, with a checklist. Adding items from the registry itself goes through the shadcn MCP server (`npx @kadal/ui mcp`), which serves every registry in components.json.
